content: Recommended Hebrew Google Fonts for UI + on-image captions: Heebo (Roboto's Hebrew companion, clean/contemporary, well-spaced) and Assistant (contemporary sans, 6 weights). Both are free Google Fonts with full Hebrew glyph coverage and good mobile legibility. Noto Sans Hebrew is a safe universal fallback with broad Unicode coverage. Hebrew typography needs slightly larger font sizes and generous word-spacing; avoid letter-spacing which breaks Hebrew letterforms.
